name: Actual JAC_Resources.CurrentYear on epic GameSpeedTurnCollection: turns 1/25/41 are 1534/1540/1543 in Gameplay logs and engine calendar

steps.code: local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=204 or h~=88 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('initial major count') end; local cities=0; for i=0,21 do cities=cities+Players[i]:GetCities():GetCount() end; if cities~=56 then error('initial city count '..cities) end; return '15 km historical map: 22 majors, 56 cities'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local t,c=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do t=t+1; if not string.find(row.TechnologyType,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech: '..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do c=c+1; if not string.find(row.CivicType,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic: '..row.CivicType) end end; if t~=32 or c~=30 then error('wrong tree counts '..t..'/'..c) end; if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name~='LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME' then error('Sengoku era missing') end; if not GameClimate or not GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange or not Game.GetWorldCongress then error('GS core APIs missing') end; if GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange()==nil or not Game.GetWorldCongress() then error('GS systems inactive') end; return '32 techs, 30 civics, GS systems present'

local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
if turn~=1 or GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()~=1 then error('unexpected calendar turn '..turn) end
local speed=GameInfo.GameSpeeds[GameConfiguration.GetGameSpeedType()]
if not speed or speed.GameSpeedType~='GAMESPEED_EPIC' then error('wrong speed') end
local rows=speed.GameSpeedTurnCollection
if type(rows)~='table' or #rows~=99 then error('ordered epic calendar collection unavailable') end
local api=ExposedMembers.JAC_Resources
if not api or type(api.CurrentYear)~='function' then error('actual resource year getter unavailable') end
local actual=api.CurrentYear()
local line='[JAC_RESOURCES_YEAR] ctx=GameCore turn='..turn..' year='..tostring(actual)..' rows='..#rows
print(line)
if actual~=1534 then error('resource year '..tostring(actual)..' expected 1534') end
return line
